title: 第3章 3V5第4章 被压制的上单潘森
content_zh:
第三章 3V5
“五楼上单，不给就送。”
看着屏幕上BAN选英雄时，这位‘赢了吃键盘’的发言。苏环一阵无语。
果然不管在哪个世界，煞笔还是有很多的。
而袁世凯看见后，也是知道遇到二逼了，而且这种人，一般都是坑货无极限，有些愧疚的看着苏环。
“不好意思啊，苏环。要是不跟我双排的话，可能就遇不到这种白痴了。”
袁世凯知道，英雄联盟在苏环心中有着非常重要的地位，在这个渐渐以英雄联盟为主导的世界里。
有着许许多多怀有梦想的少年，想通过这个游戏平台，来展示自己的实力。
而具他了解，苏环是一位孤儿，在高中同他女朋友相恋后，相继考上科技大学。
却想不到其女朋友却是投入别人的怀抱，而且理由也是奇葩，对方段位高。
所以在袁世凯心中则认为，英雄联盟这款游戏在苏环心中有着非常重要的意义。
“没事，这种人我见多了，说要送其实最多就是挂个机而已，4V5的话，不是没有一定的胜算的。”苏环不在意的笑了笑，却是说了实话。
要知道在前世，他就是从英勇黄铜一步一步凭着实力的进步，硬生生的打上去的。
可以说是历尽艰辛，期间各种类型的人都见过，这种人反而不是让人最气愤的，因为对方一上来瞬间就暴露了智商，让人一下子就知道对方是个二货，所以大抵都有做好了输的准备。
而在第一次苏环打璀璨钻石I晋级最强王者的晋级赛中，当时已经是两胜两负。
最后一把却是顺风，当时准备大龙逼团，团灭对方，拿下最后一胜的时候。
中单AP酒桶来了一句，“不好意思啊，我要睡觉了。”
“纳尼。。”
“。。。。”
酒桶看见屏幕那些表示不解的符号，无奈抱歉的说道。

“学校要断网了，我也是没办法。”
当时的苏环就只觉得胸口一阵气愤难耐。
你说你本来就知道要断网了，你还来打排位做什么，去打打极地大乱斗那种只需十几分钟的战斗，结束后不就正好可以睡觉了吗。
最后，由于少了一个重要的C位，那最后一把晋级赛输了。
所以今天遇到这种状况苏环可以说基本没影响到什么心情，至于4V5或许在高段位上有些难度，但是在不屈白银阶段打打，却是毫无压力的。
“已经连跪五把了，各位大神求给力啊，求终结，顺便三楼求个中单，绝对不坑。”
在那位‘赢了吃键盘’刚刚发出的信息后，几乎同一时间一位叫‘不想再跪了’玩家发出信息。
不过当他发出后，却是看到那‘赢了吃键盘’发出的信息。
一瞬间‘不想再跪了’直接怒了。
|“又是你这个挂机狗，草。”
苏环一看，乐了，得。这一把还是己方的恩怨局，看来有得玩了。
“原来是你这个坑逼啊，中单打得跟翔一样，还好意思说我。”
“要不是你在上路直接超鬼，然后挂机，我会被抓成那样？”
由于苏环是在一楼BAN选位，所以随意BAN掉几个英雄后，直接秒选了一个瑞雯。随后他也懒得打字，直接开启游戏内的自带语音，说道。
“一楼上单。”
然后他就不说话。
“一楼你煞笔吗，说了五楼上单，眼睛瞎了吗？”
苏环看到了，不过对于这种逗比，他直接无视。
“行，一楼你吊，真以为我不敢挂机啊。”
而这期间三楼‘不想再跪了’也是对着五楼‘赢了吃键盘’一阵冷嘲热讽。

至于三楼为什么知道五楼是坑货，而不去秒退。
三楼表示，由于英雄联盟规则太坑爹，秒退的话，至少一个小时是不能进入游戏的。
这规则也是和前世的英雄联盟不一样的地方。
但却极大的限制了玩家，遇到技术不怎么样想要秒退重入游戏的心态。
二楼到现在一句话没说，相当冷艳。不过估计也是对胜利没什么希望了，也就随意选了一个曙光女神蕾欧娜，充当辅助位。
三楼‘不想再跪了’则是选了一位发条魔灵奥利安娜，目前虽然不是目前非BAN必选的英雄，但是也是相当的强势。
而四楼则是袁世凯了，选了一位皮城女警凯特琳，配合曙光女神的硬控，可以说前期是非常强势的一对组合。
至于五楼，则是秒选了奶妈，重生加传送，相当的炫酷。
“奶妈需不需要我去对面泉水插个眼，让你来个千里送人头，我相信肯定非常的有威慑力的。”
苏环心态非常的轻松，对于他来说今天刚刚穿越而来，心情肯定有些迷茫的，但是却遇到了这位奶妈，却是他的心情调剂品。
“哼，等下你就笑不出来了。”
对于‘赢了吃键盘’来说，他也是非常的不想挂机的，在以前只要他在五楼就会来那么一句。
队友虽然会骂他，但是他要的位置却会留给他。
哪里想到今天来了个硬茬子，堵得他心里有些郁闷。
但是说出去的话，泼出去的水，说了挂机自然不能食言，不然岂不是弱了自己的气势？
等下自己就切出去，看看今天的新番，坐等他们二十投。
‘赢了吃键盘’心里暗暗的想到。
双方选定英雄，游戏开始。
苏环是蓝色方的，己方阵容是上单瑞雯，中单发条，下路女警加日女。
看着己方阵容，苏环暗暗点头，这种阵容完全可以4V5的。

当然这要建立在前期不被打爆的情况下。
紫色方的上单是潘森，中单豹女，打野盲僧，下路是伊泽瑞尔加琴女，亦是常规阵容。
进入游戏后，见对面上路是潘森，苏环则是出了一个多兰盾外加一瓶血瓶。
由于一级的潘森对上瑞雯，都有一种心理上的压制，基本都是无脑消耗。
所以苏环为了在一级不被消耗惨了，选择有些稳妥的出装。
苏环是不打算一级团的，而且己方又没有打野位，所以选择了直接去上路。
而紫色方则是毫不犹豫的入侵的蓝色方的野区，他们也看出来了，对方估计是内讧了，二楼一个日女，五楼却是一个奶妈。
难道是想要日女打野，别开玩笑了。而且对面奶妈重生加传送，经典的挂机流。
在时间来到一分三十秒之后，随着系统“全军出击”的声音，游戏正式开始了。
然而这时候，袁世凯却是拍了拍苏环。
见到苏环疑惑看了过来，袁世凯有些蛋疼的指着屏幕道：“日女好像掉了。”
“什么？”苏环有些无语。
随后他切换了下视角，果然那日女安静的待在泉水里，身上没有任何装备。
“日女在吗？”苏环默默的打字道。
没有回应。
好吧，看来这把是要3V5的节奏了。
想到这，苏环没有什么沮丧的情绪，反而内心有一股激荡的情感涌现，心中热血汹涌澎湃。
这时，他非常大喊一声放逐之刃瑞雯的经典台词。
即使剑是断的，整个局面我也能Hold住。
即使这把是3V5的艰难局面，苏环表示这更是让他充满斗志。
content_en:
Chapter 3 3V5
"If you place an order on the fifth floor, it will be delivered."
When looking at the BAN selection hero on the screen, this person said, "If you win, you will eat the keyboard." Su Huan was speechless for a while.
Sure enough, no matter which world you are in, there are still many evil pens.
When Yuan Shikai saw it, he also knew that he had met a second-hand man, and this kind of people usually cheated without limit, so he looked at Su Huan guiltily.
"I'm sorry, Su Huan. If you didn't play in double queue with me, you might not have met such an idiot."
Yuan Shikai knew that the League of Legends held a very important position in Su Huan's heart, in a world that was gradually dominated by the League of Legends.
There are many young people with dreams who want to show their strength through this gaming platform.
As he learned, Su Huan was an orphan. After falling in love with his girlfriend in high school, he was admitted to the University of Science and Technology one after another.
But he didn't expect that his girlfriend would fall into the arms of someone else, and the reason was also weird, because the other party was of high rank.
Therefore, Yuan Shikai believes that the game League of Legends has a very important meaning in Su Huan's heart.
"It's okay. I've seen this kind of people a lot. If you want to give them away, the most you can do is hang up. If it's 4V5, there's a certain chance of winning." Su Huan smiled nonchalantly, but he told the truth.
You must know that in his previous life, he rose up from the heroic brass step by step based on his improvement in strength.
It can be said that he has gone through many hardships, and has met various types of people during this period. This kind of person is not the most infuriating, because the other party's intelligence is exposed instantly when he comes up, and people immediately know that the other party is a second-rate person, so they are probably prepared to lose.
In the first promotion match where Su Huan played the Brilliant Diamond I to advance to the strongest king, there were already two wins and two losses.
The last move was Tongfeng, when I was preparing for the dragon to force the team, destroy the opponent, and win the final victory.
Mid laner AP Jiugong said, "Sorry, I'm going to bed."
"Nani..."
"..."
Jiugong saw the puzzled symbols on the screen and said helplessly and apologetically.
"The school is going to cut off the internet, and I can't do anything about it."
At that time, Su Huan felt a burst of anger in his chest.
You said that you knew that the Internet was going to be disconnected, so why did you come to play ranked games? To fight in a battle like Super Smash Bros. that only takes ten minutes. After that, you can just go to bed.
In the end, due to the lack of an important C position, the last promotion round was lost.
So it can be said that Su Huan's mood was not affected at all when he encountered this situation today. As for 4V5, it may be a bit difficult at high levels, but playing in the Unyielding Silver stage is stress-free.
"I've been kneeling for five games in a row. Please help me, all the masters. Please give me an end. By the way, please give me a mid laner on the third floor. I will definitely not cheat."
After the message just sent by the player who "wins and eats the keyboard", a player named "I don't want to kneel anymore" sent a message at almost the same time.
But when he sent it, he saw the message "win and eat the keyboard".
For a moment, I didn't want to kneel anymore and I got angry.
| "It's you, you idle dog again, you idiot."
When Su Huan saw it, he was happy. This one is still a grudge match between one's own side, and it looks like it's going to be fun.
"It turns out you're the one who's cheating. The mid laner plays like Xiang, but you still have the nerve to criticize me."
"If you hadn't just overtaken the ghost on the top lane and then AFK, would I have been caught like that?"
Since Su Huan was banning on the first floor, he randomly selected a few heroes and then directly selected Riven. Then he didn't bother to type, so he directly turned on the in-game voice and said.
"Order on the first floor."
Then he stopped talking.
"Are you making a mistake on the first floor? Are you blind when you say you are the top orderer on the fifth floor?"
Su Huan saw it, but he ignored the joke.
"Okay, you hang up on the first floor, reallyI thought I didn’t dare to hang up. "
During this period, the third floor's "I don't want to kneel anymore" was also sarcastic towards the fifth floor's "win and eat the keyboard".
As for why the third floor knew that the fifth floor was a scam and didn’t immediately withdraw.
The third floor said that because the rules of League of Legends are too cheating, if you log out instantly, you will not be able to enter the game for at least an hour.
This rule is also different from the previous League of Legends.
However, it greatly limits the mentality of players who want to exit and re-enter the game instantly when their skills are not very good.
The second floor has not said a word until now, it is quite cold. But I guess I had no hope of victory, so I randomly chose Leona, the goddess of dawn, to serve as a support player.
On the third floor, ‘I don’t want to kneel anymore’ chose Oriana, the Clockwork Demon. Although it is not a must-choose hero for non-BANs, it is still quite strong.
On the fourth floor is Yuan Shikai. He chose Caitlin, a Piltover policewoman, and combined with the hard control of the Dawn Goddess, it can be said that they are a very strong combination in the early stage.
As for the fifth floor, you can choose a wet nurse instantly, reborn and teleported, which is quite cool.
"Nanny, do you need me to poke a hole in the spring across the way so that you can kill me thousands of miles away? I believe it will be very intimidating. "
Su Huan's mentality was very relaxed. For him, he had just traveled through time today, so he must have been a little confused, but meeting this nanny was a mood booster for him.
“Hmph, you won’t be able to laugh anymore later. "
As for "win and eat the keyboard", he also really doesn't want to hang up. In the past, he would say this whenever he was on the fifth floor.
Although his teammates will scold him, the position he wants will be reserved for him.
He didn't expect that something tough would happen today, which made him feel a little depressed.
But when you say it out loud, you throw water out, and you can't break your promise after saying hang up, otherwise wouldn't it weaken your own momentum?
I'll cut out later, watch today's new show, and wait for their twenty shots.
‘If I win, I’ll eat the keyboard’ I thought to myself.
Both sides select heroes and the game begins.
Su Huan is on the blue side, and his team's lineup is top laner Riwen, mid laner Clockwork, and bottom lane policewoman plus Japanese girl.
Looking at his own lineup, Su Huan nodded secretly. This lineup is completely suitable for 4V5.
Of course, this is based on not being blown up in the early stage.
The top laner on the purple side is Panson, the mid laner is Leopard Girl, the jungler is Lee Sin, and the bottom lane is Ezreal and Qin Girl, which is also a regular lineup.
After entering the game, I saw Pan Sen on the opposite side of the road, and Su Huan produced a Dolan Shield and a blood bottle.
Because Level 1 Pan Sen faced off against Riven, there was a kind of psychological suppression, which was basically mindless consumption.
Therefore, in order to avoid being consumed at level one, Su Huan chose some safe equipment.
Su Huan didn't plan to join a first-level team, and he didn't have a jungle position, so he chose to go directly to the top lane.
The purple side invaded the blue side's wild area without hesitation. They also saw that the other side was probably having internal strife. There was a Japanese girl on the second floor and a wet nurse on the fifth floor.
Could it be that he wants Japanese women to play jungle? Don't be kidding. Moreover, the nanny on the opposite side is reborn and teleported, a classic idle flow.
After the time came to one minute and thirty seconds, with the sound of the system saying "all troops attack", the game officially started.
However, at this time, Yuan Shikai patted Su Huan.
Seeing Su Huan look over in confusion, Yuan Shikai pointed at the screen with some pain and said: "The Japanese girl seems to have dropped. "
"What? "Su Huan was speechless.
Then he switched the perspective, and sure enough, the girl was sitting quietly in the spring that day, without any equipment on her body.
"Is the Japanese girl here? "Su Huan typed silently.
No response.
Well, it seems that this one is going to be at the 3V5 pace.
Thinking of this, Su Huan didn't feel depressed. Instead, he felt a surge of emotion in his heart, and his heart was filled with passion.
At this time, he shouted veryA classic line from Riven, the Exile Blade.
Even if the sword is broken, I can hold the whole situation.
Even though this was a difficult 3V5 situation, Su Huan said that it made him full of fighting spirit.
